plan: Deep-copy the recipe, resolve excluded ingredients recursively, and preserve the authored original text.
Select substitutions by numeric priority and catalog order; track chains, wording edits, equipment changes, added ingredients, and yield effects.
Scale all final quantities with Fraction arithmetic, validate equipment and exclusions, and return sorted warnings or all impossibility reasons.
mechanisms: Recursive substitution resolution with per-ingredient ancestry for cycle detection
Stable catalog index sorted by (priority, catalog position)
Generic traversal of component ingredient, instruction, and equipment collections
Deferred exact Fraction scaling after substitution yield adjustments
Deep copies and immutable reads to prevent input mutation
